hookups.source: https://buffalocountyfairgrounds.com/about-us/faqs/ ('There are electrical hook ups, water and a dump station located on the grounds. We have 20, 30 and 50 amp hook ups.'; water is described as on the grounds, not at the sites), read 2026-11-04

facilities.source: https://buffalocountyfairgrounds.com/about-us/faqs/ ('electrical hook ups, water and a dump station located on the grounds'; 'We do not have a bathhouse available.'), read 2026-11-04

values.note: First come, first served. Pay at the fair office (M-F 8-5) or the black drop box outside its doors after hours. No long-term camping; stays over 5 days are discussed with the office first.

booking.source: https://buffalocountyfairgrounds.com/about-us/faqs/ ('We are a first come first serve camping facility. We do not offer long term camping. If you plan to stay longer than 5 days please stop in our office and discuss your travel situation.'), read 2026-11-04

season.source: https://buffalocountyfairgrounds.com/about-us/faqs/ gives no season; 'year-round' rested on directory prose only. Read 2026-11-04

values.note: $20 a night ('as of September 1st, 2022', still the posted rate on the fairgrounds FAQ, page updated July 2026). During fair week there are no electric hookups; camping then is in flagged sites on the southeast side, by arrangement with the office.

fees.source: https://buffalocountyfairgrounds.com/about-us/faqs/ ('It is $20 a night for camping, as of September 1st, 2022.'), read 2026-11-04

note: Buffalo County fairgrounds in Kearney: by-the-night RV camping outside fair week, not event-only. Fair week (July 21-26 in 2027): no electrical hookups; call the office to camp in the flagged sites east of the Extension Building. --Claude
